text: {"frames":["Anke pulls the hoist beam, and the crooked house in Misty Ford lights up window by window. Nobody lives there, but warm bread smells roll down the canal, and under the water the bell of the drowned village rings once, very softly. Anke counts the glowing windows and finds {c} of them. She must send the light down the two stairs so that each gets the same share. How many windows does each stair get, half of {c}?","A ferry without a rope drifts out of the reeds, and Edith, who has not spoken since the ice came, taps the old map with one finger. The map shows a canal nobody remembers, with {c} locks marked along it in faded ink. Edith rows out, and the water under the boat is already clear and waiting. She means to share the locks fairly with the lock-keeper's children. How many locks does each child open, half of {c}?","In the cheese cellar the music comes from behind a wheel of cheese, and the rule is pinned to the wall: whoever can stay quiet the longest keeps the tune. Mieke and Piet sit down on the straw and nobody moves. After {c} long breaths, Piet's ear twitches, and he taps the floor. The tune belongs to whoever gets the cheese wheels, and they split the cellar evenly. How many wheels of cheese does the winner take, half of {c}?","The stairs keep climbing past the last step, and the plan in Grandmother Angus's apron pocket shows only the ground floor and the attic. Her needles click on a grey scarf that has grown longer than the stairs. She bets you a waffle that the floor between them has {c} rooms, and that they can be shared out fairly between two lamps. Each lamp should light the same number of rooms. How many rooms does each lamp light, half of {c}?","Hurry, the footprints are walking across the canal ice towards the mill, and they stop right at the water. Ruun kneels down, opens a jar and watches the fog pour out in a silver spiral. There are {c} jars of fog on her shelf, and the thief must be stopped before the frost sets in. Ruun wants to split the jars between herself and her friend Bram so that neither has more. How many jars does each of them keep, half of {c}?"]}
